detail: The national heritage inventory identifies the two retained gates, short standing masonry segments, four restored approaches, the circular 1997 earthen memorial with 8.1 m lamp, the southeast exhibition hall and the northeast student memorial of 2002.
National Museum of History records the 4.3 m historic wall height, four projecting corners and partial masonry survival. That height limits the raised fragments.
National tourism agency records 3.4 m arched gate openings and tiled roof pavilions.
The ceremonial mound has 81 steps in its approach system and an 8.1 m lamp-shaped central monument.
